description: This source file defines the GrainCancellationToken class within the Orleans framework, providing an analogue to CancellationToken that can be sent between grains, including methods for cancellation, managing grain references, and serialization aspects.

classes.name: GrainCancellationToken
classes.description: An analogue to CancellationToken that can be passed between grains in Orleans, managing cancellation signals and remote grain references.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels the token, either locally via the CancellationTokenSource or remotely via the runtime.

methods.name: AddGrainReference
methods.description: Associates a grain reference with this token for remote cancellation notifications.
